integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from the idempotent equations and the strict cardinality inequality \(|\mathbb F_q^\times|<|\mathbb F_q|\). Small-field checks are illustrative and are not used as an infinite-family proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Existence and sharp minimum dimension only. The result does not count admissible parameters or isomorphism classes, does not classify all two-dimensional idempotent-free evolution algebras, and does not extend the counting argument to arbitrary infinite fields.
title: Every finite field admits a two-dimensional idempotent-free perfect evolution algebra
